tools.name: ceche_m1_rdap
tools.description: Look up domain registration data via RDAP. Returns registration status, creation date, expiry date, registrar, and age-based multiplier.

tools.name: ceche_m2_tld
tools.description: Score the TLD (Top-Level Domain) based on market demand. Returns TLD score (0.2-10) and weight profile.

tools.name: ceche_m3_length
tools.description: Score the domain based on SLD length. Returns sigmoid-based multiplier with digit penalty.

tools.name: ceche_m6_segment
tools.description: Segment domain name into words and determine commercial intent (high/mid/low/brandable).

tools.name: ceche_m8_spam
tools.description: Check domain against spam blacklists (Spamhaus DBL/ZRD, URIBL, SURBL). Returns spam severity and multiplier.

tools.name: ceche_search_domain
tools.description: Check domain availability and basic info via RDAP. Returns availability status, registrar, expiry, and nameservers.

tools.name: ceche_m11_dns_history
tools.description: Get domain ownership history via WhoisXML API. Returns drops, registrar changes, years active, and registrant info.

tools.name: ceche_m12_authority
tools.description: Measure domain authority using WhoisXML Domain Reputation API. Returns reputation score, risk level, and parked status.
